name: L'air du temps
address: rue de la Croix Monet 2, 5310, Liernu
lunchNoteNl: Zelfde menu bij de lunch · do–vr

menus.name: Suprématie menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner. Five sequences of three preparations each: the Signature dishes with extra preparations. Prestige wines €250, alcohol-free pairing €65.

menus.name: Signature menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner. Five sequences of two preparations each.

menus.name: Produits d'exception menu
menus.note: Four luxury dishes (carabinero prawns, king crab, wagyu with black truffle). Only when ordered ahead.

bookingOpens: Online through Resengo on the restaurant's website, or by phone. Choose the menu when booking: one menu for the whole table.
cancellation: A credit card number is taken as a guarantee only; nothing is charged when booking.
groups: Online bookings are for up to six people. A private room with its own open kitchen, terrace and garden seats 8 to 18 (all-inclusive Suprématie formula €405 a person, with wines, water and coffee); the whole restaurant can be booked from 20 guests.
dressCode: Smart dress is requested (tenue de ville).
